column1: # comment: Bridge2AI-Voice confounders/, diagnosis/, and pediatric/ (pediatric_medical_conditions) clinical signs, symptoms, and medical-history conditions mapped to HPO. Conditions/diseases are mapped to their best-fit HPO phenotype (exact where HPO has the term, broad/related to the nearest phenotype otherwise); diseases with no defensible HPO phenotype (e.g. cystic fibrosis, multiple sclerosis, COVID-19, trisomy 21) are left for a future MONDO layer. Medications, procedures, substances, and injuries are out of scope. Every object_id verified against the pinned HPO release with oaklib. Revised after clinical review (2026-08-24) - a 'X cancer' column broadMatches the HPO neoplasm term rather than matching it exactly, because the HPO term covers benign neoplasms too. See docs/mapping-conventions.md.
